type BeforeStrict = number;
interface BeforeStrictInterface { x: number }
'use strict';
const strictObject:any=Object.freeze({x:1});
try { strictObject.x=2; } catch { console.log('program strict'); }
function strictTypes() {
  type Local=number;
  interface LocalInterface { x: number }
  'use strict';
  const object:any=Object.freeze({x:1});
  try { object.x=2; } catch { console.log('function strict'); }
}
strictTypes();
